name: Steamed Garnet Sweet Potato Mash (Peeled & Pureed)
whyItWorks: Thick, silky puree made from steamed peeled garnet yams, whipped with a pinch of sea salt and bone broth. A soluble fiber powerhouse that coats and soothes mucosal linings without mechanical scratching.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Peel skins deeply, cut into chunks, steam for 15 minutes until collapsing soft, and mash or blend with chicken bone broth and sea salt until completely lump-free.
